metric_definitions.alarm_episode: A rising edge in a detector alert stream over eligible observations, grouped per vehicle and dataset; clearing is the next eligible inactive observation.
metric_definitions.detection_delay_s: First eligible active-label alert timestamp minus the first active-label timestamp; only detected events contribute to delay summaries.
metric_definitions.eligible_observation: Detector's eligible prediction joined to a label by (time_s, vehicle_id); fusion and staged states require joint eligibility.
metric_definitions.event_detected: At least one detector alert on an eligible observation with attack_active=1 for that case; each seed/case is one event.
metric_definitions.normal_fpr: False-positive eligible observations divided by all eligible normal-label observations; pooled rates sum counts before division.
metric_definitions.post_attack_alert: Alert at an eligible observation at or after onset_s + duration_s, after the attack label is inactive.
metric_definitions.staged_outputs: staged_fast_suspect is immediate M5 output; staged_corroborated is separately measured corroborated suspicion; no confirmed-spoofing interpretation.

prediction_protocol: For each normal/attack GPS file, all M5, M8, OR, AND and staged predictions are written before that file's labels are opened. Detector code receives GPS observations only.
